snippet.title: Bachelor Party [Atari 2600] (1982) gameplay
snippet.description:
🎮 Bachelor Party (Atari 2600, 1982 / Mystique) | Walkthrough & Review

Full gameplay walkthrough and review of Bachelor Party, a notorious adult arcade title developed and published by Mystique in 1982 for the 8-bit Atari 2600 (Atari VCS) console!

Gameplay:

Bachelor Party is the gender-swapped counterpart to Bachelorette Party (an "x-rated" version of Breakout). Players control the paddle to bounce a man across the screen so he comes in contact with the waiting women, scoring points with each one he touches before bouncing back. If you miss him, you lose a turn. Featuring unique character animations and rare collectible status from the golden era of the Atari VCS, the title was later reissued by PlayAround following Mystique's exit from the market.
